claims.evidence: Origin of import cannot be determined through photos.
The witness identified the item as a generic game console; the specific model sticker or logo was not reported.
No photos or clips show the console powered on or connected to a display.
The console is wrapped in clear plastic, which can hide scratches, scuffs, or cracks on the surface.

risks.risk: Internal hardware failure (e.g., Blue Light of Death)
risks.proof: A video showing the console booting up to the main dashboard.
risks.if_unproven: As a non-working unit for parts.

risks.risk: Faulty disc drive (unable to read or eject discs)
risks.proof: A video of a game disc being inserted, recognized by the system, and ejected.
risks.if_unproven: As a digital-only console with a broken drive.

risks.risk: Controller stick drift or button failure
risks.proof: A clip of the controller being used to navigate the system menu without ghost inputs.
risks.if_unproven: As having a faulty controller requiring replacement.

risks.risk: Storage capacity is lower than expected or drive is failing
risks.proof: A photo of the 'System Storage' screen in the settings menu.
risks.if_unproven: As the minimum base model capacity (500GB).

proof_requests: Photo of the model and serial number sticker on the console.
Video of the console powering on and reaching the home screen.
Photo of the 'System Information' screen showing the software version and storage capacity.
Photo of the console with the plastic wrap removed to inspect the surface.
response.reason: The witness could not confirm the brand or model, and there is no evidence of the console's working state. A specific model must be confirmed to establish a baseline price.
